decision_reasons: The official repository has no detected license and contains no LICENSE file at the qualified revision.
The README does not state code or RefSel checkpoint license, redistribution, or bundling terms.
The RefSel checkpoint is exposed through mutable Google Drive/Baidu folders without an upstream SHA256 or size manifest.
The project publishes no isolated official RefSel inference entry point or measured CPU/Windows contract.

preprocessing_observations.input: Concatenate low-quality and reference tensors along channels (6 channels total).
preprocessing_observations.normalization: torchvision ToTensor followed by mean/std 0.5 normalization to approximately [-1, 1].
preprocessing_observations.upstream_channel_note: The published test path passes OpenCV-loaded images through ToTensor without an explicit BGR-to-RGB conversion before RefSel.
preprocessing_observations.output: Two-class logits; softmax channel 0 is returned as the reference-selection mask.
